messages:
nina-fin: Noticed a weird embed undercount for BluePeak after their index re-ingest last week. System applied a small refund ($678). Posting summary and asking ops + CS to confirm before any reversal.

omar-ops: Which re-ingest? job id?

nina-fin: reingest job bg-2026-03-10-01. Ledger quick rollup showed inserts 98,210 vs deletes 101,210 => net -3,000 embed units.

ledger-bot: Auto-rule "reingest_decrement_guard" triggered for customer=bluepeak during 2026-03-10..2026-03-11. Credits: 3,000 embed units; amount $678. See /billing/credits/11077

julia-cs: BluePeak flagged the invoice this morning. They prefer transparency before adjustments. Please don't reverse without a customer call.

omar-ops: Ops note: the re-ingest pipeline drops any object missing the external_id, which can create delete events on replace. We'll patch pipeline to map missing external_id -> preserve existing key. ETA 3 days. We'll also run a reconcile dry-run to estimate impact.

nina-fin: Finance preference: hold the credit until CS talk + ops validation. If ops confirms platform error, reverse credit and reissue invoice; if expected behavior, leave as-is.

vendor-bluepeak: Thanks for flagging. We did run a partial reindex and expected counts to go up, not down. Happy to join a 15m call.

billing-bot: Created ticket BILL-5120 assigned to billing-team. Attachments: ledger diff CSV, reingest job link.

nina-fin: I'll draft CS note and wait for ops audit. Marking P2 for now; escalate if more customers affected. :mag_right:
